verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a sandbox or test environment for Mastra Knowledge that is isolated from production data. Scopes are per-tenant read/write isolation, not a test sandbox. `mastra dev` opens a local Studio view of Knowledge but is not described as separating test data from production. Pointing Knowledge at a different storage provider would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
